articles.title: BlackRock brings tokenized money market funds to Europe via JPMorgan
articles.description: JPMorgan’s Kinexys platform will tokenize select BlackRock money market fund shares denominated in pounds, euros and US dollars.

articles.title: Proof of Play to shut down after blockchain gaming thesis falls short
articles.description: The a16z-backed studio will open-source Pirate Nation assets, while an independent foundation continues supporting the PIRATE token.

articles.title: Forgd brings its crypto market-maker leaderboard to DefiLlama
articles.description: Forgd’s ratings draw on data from more than 500 token projects and 35 market-making firms, but do not solely reflect trading performance.

articles.title: Boerse Stuttgart Digital, Tradias close European crypto merger
articles.description: The completed tie-up combines Boerse Stuttgart Digital’s custody business with Tradias’ trading operations under a joint management team.

articles.title: MiCA list expands with 12 companies in fourth post-deadline update
articles.description: ESMA’s latest MiCA update brings the number of authorized CASPs to 321 and adds three entities to its non-compliant register.

articles.title: Taiwan plans Travel Rule for domestic crypto transfers from October
articles.description: Taiwan’s regulator plans to apply the Travel Rule to domestic VASP transfers from October before extending it to overseas platforms by the end of 2027.

articles.title: Missouri trio charged over alleged Bitcoin kidnapping plot
articles.description: The defendants allegedly traveled from Missouri to Connecticut to kidnap a Bitcoin holder and force him to transfer cryptocurrency before abandoning the plan.

articles.title: Cloudflare introduces wallets for AI agents, plans stablecoin payments
articles.description: Cloudflare introduced programmable Wallets for AI agents and said payment features using stablecoins will launch in a future update.

articles.title: AI credit bubble could fuel Bitcoin ‘crack-up boom’ past $1M: Hayes
articles.description: Hayes likened the debt-fueled AI infrastructure boom to the 2008 credit bubble, but evidence suggests financial strain is uneven across Big Tech.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: CLARITY or not, crypto isn’t going back in the bottle: Bitwise
articles.description: Matt Hougan argues that regulatory guidance from the SEC and CFTC would keep the industry moving even if Congress fails to pass landmark market structure legislation this year.

articles.title: Bybit’s EU payments arm secures Austrian e-money license
articles.description: Bybit’s Austrian payments subsidiary gained regulatory approval to develop card, merchant, open-banking and person-to-person payment services.

articles.title: Ethereum researchers want to rein in staking; critics say it could backfire
articles.description: EIP-8363 is a newly published draft proposal that would cut net consensus-layer rewards as the Ethereum staking ratio heads toward 50%.

articles.title: US, UK reaffirm support for stablecoins, tokenization in joint financial regulation talks
articles.description: In a July 8 meeting, US and UK regulators highlighted the implementation of the GENIUS Act, payment modernization and cross-border cooperation, reinforcing a shared framework for digital asset oversight.

articles.title: BNY to offer institutional crypto staking through Galaxy partnership
articles.description: The custody giant is expanding beyond safekeeping by adding staking services, allowing eligible institutional clients to earn yield on proof-of-stake assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin coils at $64K as Hormuz reopening timeline sends S&P 500 to $70T record
articles.description: Bitcoin built on $64,000 as hopes of the Strait of Hormuz reopening to oil traffic sent the S&P 500 index to a record $70 trillion market cap.

articles.title: Bitdeer expands AI infrastructure with long-term $4.7B data center lease
articles.description: A 16-year agreement secures 121 megawatts of AI computing capacity in Norway, highlighting how crypto mining companies continue to pursue new revenue streams beyond Bitcoin.

articles.title: At least 15 attackers exploited Coldcard vulnerability: Galaxy
articles.description: Galaxy said that at least 15 different attackers have exploited the Coldcard vulnerability, which may have been avoided with just $2 worth of AI hardening, according to Dragonfly’s managing partner.

articles.title: Sorry everyone, Bitcoin is headed down to $43,500: Michael Terpin
articles.description: Transform Ventures founder Michael Terpin says Bitcoin could have another 30% downside from its current price before he is confident the market has reached a bottom.

articles.title: Texas electric grid moratorium won’t have big impact on BTC miners: Bernstein
articles.description: Monday’s announcement that Texas Governor Greg Abbott set a moratorium on approval of ERCOT-linked data centers pending an audit won’t impact miners’ approved electricity contracts.

articles.title: Tether Gold reserves rise 9.5% as gold posts worst quarter in 13 years
articles.description: XAUt added to its bullion backing during gold’s worst quarter since 2013, as tokenized commodity holder counts continued to rise.

articles.title: Italy’s biggest bank triples staked Ether ETF holdings while cutting IBIT shares
articles.description: Italy’s largest bank Intesa Sanpaolo increased its staked Ether ETF position to $7.1 million while reducing its holdings in two spot Bitcoin ETFs.

articles.title: Jim Cramer plans to sell his Bitcoin over quantum fears as BTC rises 1.6%
articles.description: The CNBC personality said he’ll sell his Bitcoin holdings due to fears about quantum computing, as some cryptocurrency investors celebrated, referencing the popular “inverse Cramer” meme.

articles.title: Former FBI supervisor admits guilt in $1M crypto theft
articles.description: A former FBI supervisory agent pleaded guilty to stealing about $1 million worth of digital assets from an adversarial country and forfeited about $925,000 in funds to government-controlled wallets.

articles.title: Strategy’s STRC retakes $90 after 24% rebound from June closing low
articles.description: The preferred shares have recovered nearly 24% from their June closing low as Strategy builds its cash reserve and repurchases STRC.

articles.title: US yen intervention puts Bitcoin, risk assets on notice for liquidity flux
articles.description: The first US-Japan joint yen intervention in 28 years came amid record bond yields and worries about the yen carry trade.

articles.title: Apple briefly removes Telegram from App Store, Gram rebounds
articles.description: Apple restored Telegram after the messaging platform removed content that violated its child safety policies and banned the user who posted it.

articles.title: NY judge denies CFTC motion to halt enforcement action against Kalshi
articles.description: The ruling leaves New York’s case against Kalshi in place while allowing the CFTC to renew its request before Judge Victor Marrero.

articles.title: Nigeria sets crypto tax collection rules for digital asset platforms
articles.description: The framework specifies how existing tax obligations apply to crypto disposals and rewards, with some withheld amounts payable in the originating token.

articles.title: Crypto firms still seeking frontier AI access; only select few have it
articles.description: Crypto executives say restricting powerful AI models may initially be justified, but it doesn’t make sense as open-source alternatives become more capable.
